name: Connections — Google
description: Google connectors for the connections framework: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Contacts

feature.label: Google connectors (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Contacts)
feature.description: OAuth client for the Google connectors (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Contacts)

vars.description: Google OAuth 2.0 client ID used by the Gmail, Drive, Calendar and Contacts connectors.

instructions: Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID (type: Web application) in Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.
Enable the Gmail, Drive, Calendar and People APIs for the project.

vars.description: Google OAuth 2.0 client secret for the same OAuth client as GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

instructions: Copy the client secret of the OAuth client created for GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.
Make sure the redirect URI <ENGENTY_API_BASE_URL>/api/connections/oauth/callback is registered on that client.
